steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, we're pretty deep in the rainforest now.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's a lot more humid here, and the trees get way denser too.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Watch your footing. Don't trip.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: There's a tribe up ahead. Let's go take a look.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: *Yawn*... It's so boring here... I'm gonna take a nap...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Inam!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Gavial? I heard you fought Zumama at the festival and got your ass handed to you. What are you doing here?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, news sure gets to you fast, Inam.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I gotta say, I thought Tomimi was pulling my leg when she said you're a tribal leader now, but here you are.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: It wasn't my decision. What can I do if they all want to follow me?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So why didn't you come to the ceremony?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, this is Inam, the girl Tomimi mentioned before.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Whoa, a real, live outsider.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Is this one of your friends from out there? Kinda shy, huh?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: The Doctor just doesn't talk much.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Yo! Gavial, you've got a pretty cheerful friend there. Just like you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? Inam, how come you know Sargonian too?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Well, officially, I'm the Messenger for these parts here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Messenger? Huh?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You... whatever. I can tell you at least know what a Messenger is.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Not like the boneheads here. Even if I told them, they wouldn't have any idea what it actually means.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Wait up. When did you become a Messenger?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I've always been a Messenger...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: We're still technically within Sargon territory. You can't possibly think they know absolutely nothing about this whole area?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? They don't though?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Of course not! As far as I know, a couple centuries ago, this actually used to be a Sargon mining colony.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: When the Catastrophe happened, the whole nomadic city moved away, and they ended up abandoning the mine.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: The people who got left behind and the ones who came back later are our ancestors here.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: And I guess the higher-ups out there are thinking about repositioning those newer cities here to start putting the mine to use again.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Like that time some ten years ago. You know the one.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, you mean that one time? Both Zumama and I saw it. That's also the day she started acting really strange.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Oh yeah? Well, I don't really know why they gave up on the idea. They probably had someone survey the area and realized the mine didn't have much value at all.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: If they did park a city here, it's gonna end up pretty far away from all the other ones.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I heard this stretch of no man's land used to be a pretty prosperous place. No idea how long ago, though.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Well, whatever. Let's talk about something else. I mean, I was like, uh...? How old was I again? Whatever, they sent me here after I became a Messenger.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Sheesh, I don't get to talk about this very often. Can't you at least pretend to be a little interested?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Nope, sounds like a pain. But if you're the Messenger here, how come I haven't ever seen you leave this place?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Of course you haven't. You know how shut off we are? I've been outside to shop, but no one's ever had anything for me to mail!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: From the day I became a Messenger to this very day, you're the only person who's still had contact with this place after you left!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: And since I've got absolutely nothing to do, I've been trading things I buy from nearby cities to make a quick buck.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: And before you know it, I'm everybody's favorite shopkeeper, Inam.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: How about that. I never knew.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: With how you used to be, I'd be more surprised if you did...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: But well, even though I grew up in the city, I definitely prefer living here.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: It's simple and laidback. What's not to like?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You don't really seem all that different from the other Liberi here, either.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I'll take that as a compliment. Anyway, what are you doing here?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Let me ask you this first. What was AUS doing here? You didn't bring them here, did you?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: AUS? Of course not. Even someone like me who hardly follows that kinda stuff knows about them. I don't have that kind of pull.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: In fact, I was probably more surprised than anybody else when I saw them.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: They really were just passing by, and I was their interpreter while they were here.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Oh, I could talk about them all day. You came at just the right time. I wasn't even sure how to brag about this when nobody here knows who they are.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Check this out! I got this autographed album!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Eh, I'll pass. I'm not a fan anyway. I just thought it was weird.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Ugh, Gavial, you've been out there so long, but your taste is just as terrible as ever.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You wanna get your ass whooped? Whatever. The Doctor and I are on our way to Zumama's, and we figured we'd stop by and resupply here.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Alright. We could just barter like everyone here does, but since you know how things work on the outside, you can pay me with cold, hard cash.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: ...Oh, wait up, I almost forgot since you were bombarding me with all these questions. I was actually looking for you for something too.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Do you have a friend called Croissant?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Croissant? Yeah, she's with us. We've been trying to find her. Have you seen her?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You should take a look over at the market.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Come one, come all! Freshly carved wood sculptures right here!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Check out these ores passed down from my grandfather! Forge weapons sharper than anything you've ever seen!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Haha, I was the one who taught them to peddle like that. It's something, isn't it?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Look, there's Croissant.
In the corner of the market, Croissant is in a fierce standoff against a lone Archosauria.
Croissant gestures toward the ore her opponent is holding, and then points to the seashell in her hand. He shakes his head.
She frowns and waves her hand with a reluctant look.
She takes a rock out of her pocket and points at her seashell again. Then, she points at the ore in his hand once more. He ponders for a moment and nods.
Throughout the entire transaction, Croissant maintains a bitter expression, but the moment her trade partner turns around, her face immediately lights up with a bright smile.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hooowee, that's a hell of an ore! What a prize!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Croissant, what are you even doing, bartering here?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gavial, Baws! Finally! Took me ages to find y'all!

options: You can talk to the people here?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Never been better!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ahaha. C'mon, Baws, why the face?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I was fixin' to have Inam here take me to that Temple to look fer y'all!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sure can't, but it ain't like you need talkin' to do business!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I came across her a couple days ago. I could tell she's not from around here, so I brought her with me.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: This girl really knows how to do business! She doesn't speak their language, but she really knows how to speak the language of trade with my men here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I can see that. Croissant, have you come across anyone else?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Naw, and I asked Inam, too, but she says she ain't heard nothin' about that either.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright, at least you're alive and well. Now we just gotta find Utage and Blaze. I'm not too worried about Blaze. She jumped out the aircraft first, didn't even think twice. As for Utage...

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: Inam, bad news. There's a group of Archosauria charging towards us!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: What? Which tribe is it? Are they out of their minds?

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: Looks like the Great Wood Tribe! But they're being led by some freak with a sword!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Huh? A freak?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: My man says a freak with a blade is charging toward us with a horde of Archosauria. What gives?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hold up, a freak carryin' a blade... Damn dagnabbit, it's gotta be Utage!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Is she with you guys? Tsk... In any case, it looks like they're here already. Gavial, and you, with the hood, come help us!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh, I'm comin' with y'all!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: C'mon, dudes, let's go!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I mean, it's not like any of you know what I'm saying, but show 'em what you got~!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Aha! I wasn't sure about this at first, but it's kinda fun taking these guys around to fight.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Utage, are you out of your mind? What are you even doing?!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, it's Gavial. Croissant and Doctor too! Heyas!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Who's heying ya?! Why are you attacking the village, and where'd you get these guys?!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Huh? Is this your hometown? Alright, I'll knock it off.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Get these fellers to knock it off too!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Uh, but, you know, they don't understand a word I say.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tch... Looks like we're out of options. Let's take these idiots down.
